messages:
maria: quick sync - i'm designing a compact 'Querybook' saved-queries list that shows routing hints + a cheap quota peek. want API + UX alignment before mocks. :wave:

alex: love it. constraint: list must remain fast. prefer cached cheap estimate in-list + detailed modal on click.

devon: agree. telemetry is noisy. show 'est tokens (7d median)' in list and a 'Quota details' modal that runs a fuller calc. add tooltip noting estimates are sampled.

kai: API tradeoff: snapshot routing (pinned_model + fallbacks + policy_ref) vs compute at read-time. Snapshot helps audits but can drift.

alex: snapshot + `stale_pin` flag is my pick. reproducibility important for enterprise. server can validate pin freshness on save.

maria: +1. migration: backfill snapshots async for hot saved-queries; read-time eval for others. enterprise can request full backfill.

devon: UX tweak: show a small flame icon for high-cost queries; hover reveals top token assumptions. helps quick triage.

kai: implementation note: analytics-service writes `estimates.cache_7d` onto saved-query doc. reads use cache; modal triggers `estimates/recalculate`.

maria: action items: alex -> API PR (snapshot, policy_ref, stale_pin); kai -> migration + cache endpoint sketch; devon -> tooltip copy + mock. i'll add to weekly sync.

sam-bot: reminder: weekly-api-standup 2pm today. adding this thread to agenda.
